# Coupled Waveguides

`maiman.components.CoupledWaveguides` · category **Photonic IC** · [all components](index.md)

A directional coupler drawn by its length, not by its split ratio.

`DirectionalCoupler` takes the ratio as given. This one derives it:
two guides whose even and odd supermodes differ in index by `delta_n`
exchange power as `sin^2(pi delta_n L / lambda)`, so the length sets the
ratio and the wavelength moves it. See
`maiman.photonics.coupled_waveguides`.

## Ports

| Port | Direction | Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `in1` | input | optical |
| `out1` | output | optical |
| `out2` | output | optical |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Range | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `length` | `10.0` | um | 0.0 …  | Length of the coupling section |
| `delta_n` | `0.04` |  | 0.0001 … 1.0 | Index difference between the even and odd supermodes; sets the coupling length |
| `insertion_loss` | `0.0` | dB | 0.0 …  | Excess loss through the coupler |
